title: Tech Note: Collection Support on Popup Dropdown List, Combo Box, and Tab Control
author: Nhat Do, Technical Services Engineer, 4D Inc.

historical_commentary.text: Object/collection-based data sources for drop-down lists, combo boxes, and tab controls (introduced in v19) are still the recommended, current approach; the classic array-based technique documented for comparison remains functional but is now considered the legacy pattern.
related_updates: No replacement needed — this collection-based object pattern for form widget data sources is still 4D's current recommended technique
Continues 4D's broader multi-year shift from arrays/pointers toward collections and objects across the whole language and form engine
